title: Production Gekta registration runtime provision and exact-SHA activation
acceptance: the owner-only command is accepted only on release issue 3072 and exact current main is rechecked before any REG.RU mutation
the protected PC_PROD_HOST must be nonempty, must equal one of the live domain's current DNS IPv4 answers and must present the pinned SSH host fingerprint
GEKTA_PHONE_ENCRYPTION_KEY is an independent 32-byte key and GEKTA_PHONE_LOOKUP_PEPPER is an independent 48-byte key stored only in a root-owned 0600 API runtime file
MFA_LOGIN_TICKET_SECRET and GEKTA_ANONYMOUS_SESSION_SECRET are distinct independent 48-byte keys stored only in a root-owned 0600 Web runtime file
API and Web consume only their own Gekta runtime file; post-release inspection proves this least privilege boundary without emitting values
existing valid protected files are preserved idempotently; duplicate directory authorities must be byte-identical and conflicting authorities fail closed without mutation
symlinks, broad paths, incomplete pairs, malformed values and unsafe permissions fail closed
workflow logs and retained artifacts publish only bounded created/existing, reconciliation and readiness markers and never secret or PII values
the exact full-stack release refuses to proceed unless both protected Gekta runtime files are valid and immutable API/Web revisions match exact current main
emergency rollback and verify-intake remain independent of the newly provisioned files and restore the recorded baseline override without injecting them
production hosting remains the existing REG.RU contour and new recurring cost remains 0 RUB
